scan_results.executive_summary: The quick scan of scan-target.vendetta.lab:8080 confirmed one high-severity SQL injection (CWE-89), one medium reflected XSS (CWE-79) and one low information disclosure (CWE-200). No other hosts were contacted.
scan_results.methodology: Black-box web assessment through the sandbox Caido proxy: surface mapping, parameter fuzzing, boolean/time-based and UNION injection probes, reflected-payload checks and error-handling review.
scan_results.technical_analysis: GET /rest/products/search is injectable through the q parameter (SQLite back-end, 9 UNION columns). The search page reflects q without output encoding. Malformed JSON to /api/Challenges returns a verbose Express stack trace.
scan_results.recommendations: Parameterise all SQL, encode reflected output and add a Content-Security-Policy, suppress X-Powered-By and stack traces, then re-run this scan to verify the fixes.
